impl Renderer {
    pub fn new(
        device: wgpu::Device,
        queue: wgpu::Queue,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
        scene: &Scene,
    ) -> Self {
        Self::with_formats(device, queue, format, format, scene)
    }

    pub fn with_formats(
        device: wgpu::Device,
        queue: wgpu::Queue,
        output_format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
        scene: &Scene,
    ) -> Self {
        crate::shader_check::check(&device, crate::clipping_gpu::source(include_str!("cloud_points.wgsl"),2,0), "Cloud points");
        crate::shader_check::check(&device, include_str!("cloud_resolve.wgsl").into(), "Cloud resolve");
        crate::shader_check::check(&device, crate::finite_project_source::source(), "Finite projection");
        crate::shader_check::check(&device, crate::finite_project_source::tiles(), "Finite tiles");
        crate::shader_check::check(&device, crate::finite_project_source::scan(), "Finite scan");
        let view_layout = crate::surface_view::layout(&device);
        let model_layout = crate::gpu_layout::uniform(&device, crate::object_record::BYTES as u64);
        let surfaces=crate::sample_pipelines::Variants::new(crate::surface_pipelines::pipelines(&device,format,&view_layout,&model_layout,1),1);
        let tiles=std::cell::RefCell::new(crate::tile_gpu::Tiles::new(&device,&view_layout));
        let instances=crate::instance_gpu::Lane::new(&device,&queue,format,&view_layout);
        let highlight = crate::highlight::Highlight::new(&device, format);
        let preview = crate::tool_preview::Preview::new(&device, format);
        let widget = crate::widget::Widget::new(&device, format);
        let uniform = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("view transform and normal diagnostic"),
            size: crate::surface_view::BYTES,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });
        let view_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("view settings"),
            layout: &surfaces.active.0.get_bind_group_layout(0),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: uniform.as_entire_binding(),
            }],
        });
        let targets = crate::frame_targets::Targets::with_formats(&device,[640,480],output_format,format,1);
        let strokes = crate::stroke_gpu::Lane::new(&device, format);
        let paths = crate::stroke_gpu::Lane::joined(&device, format);
        let markers = crate::stroke_gpu::Lane::markers(&device, format);
        let grid = crate::stroke_gpu::Lane::grid(&device, format);
        let picker = crate::pick_gpu::Picker::new(&device, &view_layout, &model_layout);
        let faces = crate::face_pick::Faces::new(&device);
        let mesh_ink = crate::stroke_gpu::Lane::new(&device, format);
        let sheets=crate::sheet_gpu::Lane::new(&device,format);
        let measurement=crate::measure_gpu::Measurement::new(&device,format);let guides=crate::guide_gpu::Guide::new(&device,format);
        let mut renderer = Self {surface_options:Default::default(),world_bounds:Default::default(),space:Default::default(),opacity:std::cell::Cell::new(1.),ambient_enabled:Default::default(),ambient:Default::default(),ambient_rows:Default::default(),pyramid:Default::default(),pyramid_revision:0,caps:std::cell::RefCell::new(crate::caps_gpu::Caps::new(&device)),clipping:std::cell::RefCell::new(crate::clipping_gpu::Clipping::new(&device)),tiles,guides,measurement,sheets,instances,instance_rows:Default::default(),clouds:Default::default(),cloud_view:Default::default(),cloud_error:Default::default(),outline:Default::default(),global_outline:Default::default(),outlines_enabled:Default::default(),outline_composite:Default::default(),full_text_fonts:Default::default(),presentation_text:Default::default(),scene_text:Default::default(), text:std::cell::RefCell::new(None),text_error:std::cell::RefCell::new(None),format,output_format,device, queue, surfaces, highlight, preview, widget, meshes: Vec::new(),
            geometry: Default::default(), settings_allocations: 0, settings_writes: 0,
            settings_bytes: 0, uniform, view_group, targets, strokes, paths, markers, grid, grid_settings: None,grid_plane:crate::cplane::CPlane::Xy,grid_anchor:[0.;3], size: [640, 480], density: 1.0, picker, faces, mesh_ink, sources: Default::default(), pick_mode:Default::default(),pick_cursor:None };
        renderer.mesh_ink.enable_finite(&renderer.device,format,true);
        for lane in [&mut renderer.strokes,&mut renderer.paths,&mut renderer.markers]{lane.enable_finite(&renderer.device,format,false);}
        renderer.highlight.enable_finite(&renderer.device,format);
        renderer.set_scene(scene, None);
        renderer
    }

    pub fn anchor(&self)->[f64;3] {self.space.anchor()}

    pub fn resize(&mut self, size: crate::viewport::Viewport) {
        if self.size == [size.width, size.height] { return; }
        self.cancel_pick();
        self.size = [size.width, size.height];
        self.targets=crate::frame_targets::Targets::with_formats(&self.device,self.size,self.output_format,self.format,self.targets.samples);
    }

    pub fn set_density(&mut self, density: f32) {
        if density.is_finite() && density > 0.0 && density != self.density { self.cancel_pick(); self.density = density; }
    }

    pub fn stroke_usage(&self) -> [u64; 4] {
        let [count, bytes] = self.strokes.usage();
        [count, bytes, self.strokes.uploads, self.strokes.uploaded_bytes]
    }

    pub fn path_usage(&self) -> [u64; 4] {
        let [count, bytes] = self.paths.usage();
        [count, bytes, self.paths.uploads, self.paths.uploaded_bytes]
    }

    pub fn point_usage(&self) -> [u64; 4] {
        let [count, bytes] = self.markers.usage();
        [count, bytes, self.markers.uploads, self.markers.uploaded_bytes]
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(crate) fn use_uniform_surface_records(&mut self) {self.instances.ordinary.clear();}

    pub fn set_scene(&mut self, scene: &Scene, selected: Option<ObjectId>) {
        let anchor=self.anchor();
        self.ambient_rows.set(scene);
        self.pyramid_revision=self.pyramid_revision.wrapping_add(1);
        self.clipping.borrow_mut().set(scene);
        if let Some(outline)=self.outline.borrow_mut().as_mut() {outline.invalidate();}
        if let Some(outline)=self.global_outline.borrow_mut().as_mut() {outline.invalidate();}
        self.cancel_pick(); self.faces.clear();
        self.preview.set(&self.device, None).expect("Empty tool preview");
        self.highlight.set(&self.device, &self.surfaces.active.0.get_bind_group_layout(1), scene, None).expect("Empty selection");
        self.set_source_ink(scene);
        let layout = self.surfaces.active.0.get_bind_group_layout(1);
        let mut old = std::mem::take(&mut self.meshes);
        for object in scene.objects().iter().filter(|row| scene.visible(row.id)) {
            let matching = old.iter().position(|row| row.id == object.id
                && std::rc::Rc::ptr_eq(&row.geometry.source, &object.mesh));
            let row = if let Some(index) = matching {
                let mut row = old.swap_remove(index);
                let [calls, bytes] = row.update(&self.queue, object,style(scene,object.id,selected==Some(object.id)));
                self.settings_writes += calls;
                self.settings_bytes += bytes;
                row
            } else {
                let geometry = self.geometry.get(&crate::text_gpu_support::GpuCtx::new(&self.device,&self.queue), &object.mesh);
                self.settings_allocations += 1;
                GpuMesh::with_geometry_at(&self.device,&layout,object,
                    style(scene,object.id,selected==Some(object.id)),geometry,anchor)
            };
            self.meshes.push(row);
        }
        drop(old);
        self.caps.borrow_mut().set_scene(&self.queue,scene,&mut self.meshes,&self.clipping.borrow().rows);
        for mesh in &mut self.meshes{mesh.set_xray(&self.queue,self.opacity.get()==0.);}
        let radii=self.ambient_rows.specs.iter().copied().collect::<std::collections::HashMap<_,_>>();for mesh in &mut self.meshes {mesh.set_ambient_radius(&self.queue,radii.get(&mesh.id.value()).copied().unwrap_or(0.));}
        self.instance_rows=crate::instance_gpu::batch_rows(self.meshes.iter().map(|row|(row.id,std::rc::Rc::as_ptr(&row.geometry)as usize,scene.instances.contains_key(&row.id))),crate::object_rows::capacity(&self.device));
        self.instances.set(&self.device,&self.queue,&mut self.meshes,&self.instance_rows,true).expect("Validated instance records fit device limits");
        self.tiles.borrow_mut().set_records(&self.device,&self.meshes,Some(&self.instances));
        self.sheets.set_anchored(&self.device,&self.queue,scene,selected.as_slice(),&self.sources.sheet_bases,anchor).expect("Prepared original sheet batches fit device limits");
        self.geometry.prune();
        if !self.meshes.iter().any(GpuMesh::selected) {self.outline.borrow_mut().take();}
        if let Err(error)=self.set_clouds(scene,selected.as_slice()) {*self.cloud_error.borrow_mut()=Some(error.to_string());}
        if let Err(error)=self.set_scene_text(scene,selected.as_slice()) {*self.text_error.borrow_mut()=Some(error.to_string());}
        *self.world_bounds.borrow_mut()=scene.bounds();
    }

    pub fn grow_camera(&self,camera:&mut crate::camera::Camera) {
        if let Some(bounds)=self.world_bounds.borrow().as_ref() {camera.grow_extent(bounds);}
    }

    pub fn camera_matrix(&self,camera:&crate::camera::Camera)->[f32;16] {camera.view_projection_anchored(self.anchor()).to_f32()}
    pub fn rebase_delay(&self,now:f64)->Option<u32> {self.space.retry_after_ms(now)}
    pub fn prepare_origin(&mut self,camera:&crate::camera::Camera,scene:&Scene,target:Option<crate::pick_sources::Target>,ids:&[ObjectId],now:f64)->Result<crate::render_space::Rebase,&'static str> {
        let previous=self.anchor();let mut frame=self.space.update(camera.target,camera.distance,now).ok_or("Invalid camera origin")?;
        frame.moved&=previous.map(f64::to_bits)!=frame.anchor.map(f64::to_bits);
        if frame.moved {
            self.pyramid_revision=self.pyramid_revision.wrapping_add(1);
            for mesh in &mut self.meshes {let[calls,bytes]=mesh.rebase(&self.queue,frame.anchor);self.settings_writes+=calls;self.settings_bytes+=bytes;}
            self.set_source_ink(scene);
            if !self.highlight.rebase_face(&self.queue,frame.anchor,target){self.set_highlight(scene,target)?;}
            self.select_objects(scene,ids)?;
            self.set_grid_on(self.grid_settings,self.grid_plane)?;
        }
        self.cloud_camera(camera);Ok(frame)
    }

    fn set_source_ink(&mut self,scene:&Scene) {
        let anchor=self.anchor();
        self.sources = crate::pick_sources::Sources::anchored(scene,anchor).expect("Prepared source topology is bounded");
        self.mesh_ink.set(&self.device, self.sources.mesh_ink.iter().copied()).expect("Prepared source edges");
        self.mesh_ink.set_ids(&self.device, self.sources.mesh_ids.iter().copied()).expect("Source edge IDs match");
        self.mesh_ink.set_records(&self.device,std::mem::take(&mut self.sources.mesh_metadata)).expect("Original ink metadata");
        self.markers.set_points(&self.device, std::mem::take(&mut self.sources.mesh_markers).into_iter().chain(scene.points().iter().filter(|row| scene.visible(row.id)).map(|row| {let mut marker=row.marker_at(anchor);if let Some(colour)=scene.face_rgba(row.id) {marker.colour=colour;}marker})).chain(scene.control_markers_at(anchor).into_iter().map(|c| c.display)))
            .expect("Prepared point placement fits the display range");
        self.paths.set_chains(&self.device, scene.paths().iter().filter(|row| scene.visible(row.id)).flat_map(|row| {let mut segments=row.segments_at(anchor);if let Some(colour)=scene.face_rgba(row.id) {for segment in &mut segments {segment.stroke.colour=colour;}}segments}))
            .expect("Prepared path placement fits the display range");
        self.strokes.set(&self.device, scene.lines().iter().filter(|row| scene.visible(row.id)).map(|row| {let mut stroke=row.stroke_at(anchor);if let Some(colour)=scene.face_rgba(row.id) {stroke.colour=colour;}stroke}))
            .expect("Prepared line placement fits the display range");
        self.markers.set_ids(&self.device, self.sources.marker_ids.iter().copied()).expect("Marker owners match");
        self.paths.set_ids(&self.device, self.sources.path_ids.iter().copied()).expect("Path owners match");
        self.strokes.set_ids(&self.device, self.sources.line_ids.iter().copied()).expect("Line owners match");
    }

    pub fn request_pick(&mut self, screen: [f32; 2], transform: [f32; 16]) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        let window = crate::pick_window::Window::new(screen, self.size, self.density).ok_or("Invalid pick cursor")?;
        let origin=self.anchor();self.picker.queue_anchored(crate::pick_gpu::Request{window,transform,density:self.density,mode:self.pick_mode},origin)?;
        self.pick_cursor=Some((screen,origin.map(f64::to_bits)));self.pump_pick(transform);Ok(())
    }

    fn pump_pick(&mut self, transform: [f32; 16]) {
        let Ok(view) = crate::pick_view::View::anchored(transform,self.size,self.density,self.anchor()) else { self.cancel_pick(); return; };
        if self.pick_mode == crate::pick_sources::Mode::Face && !self.faces.ready(self.meshes.len()) {
            self.faces.set(&self.device, &self.meshes, &self.sources.mesh_bases,&self.clipping.borrow().buffer);
        }
        if let Some(lane)=self.text.borrow_mut().as_mut() {if let Err(error)=lane.prepare(&self.text_context(),&self.text_frame(transform)) {*self.text_error.borrow_mut()=Some(error.to_string());return;}}
        self.clipping.borrow_mut().frame_anchored(&self.queue,transform,self.anchor(),self.size[1],self.density);
        self.prepare_clouds(transform);
        if let Some(request) = self.picker.next(view) {
            let mut clipping=self.clipping.borrow_mut();clipping.frame_anchored(&self.queue,transform,self.anchor(),self.size[1],self.density);
            let bytes=crate::surface_view::bytes(transform,[0.;4],self.size,self.density);self.queue.write_buffer(&self.uniform,0,&bytes);
            let tables={let mut tiles=self.tiles.borrow_mut();tiles.prepare(&self.device,&self.queue,self.size);let mut encoder=self.device.create_command_encoder(&Default::default());tiles.encode(&self.device,&mut encoder,&self.view_group,transform);self.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);tiles.map_report();crate::finite_ink::Tables{projected:tiles.projected.clone(),tiles:tiles.buffer.clone(),primitive:self.targets.primitive.view.clone()}};
            self.picker.submit_finite(&self.device, &self.queue, request,
            &self.meshes, &[&self.mesh_ink, &self.strokes, &self.paths, &self.markers], &self.faces,self.text.borrow().as_ref(),self.clouds.borrow().as_ref(),Some(&self.sheets),Some(&tables),&clipping.group,&clipping.buffer,Some(&mut self.caps.borrow_mut()),Some(&self.instances)); }
    }

    pub fn take_pick(&mut self, transform: [f32; 16]) -> Option<Result<Option<[u32; 2]>, &'static str>> {
        let view = match crate::pick_view::View::anchored(transform,self.size,self.density,self.anchor()) { Ok(view) => view, Err(error) => {
            self.cancel_pick(); return Some(Err(error));
        } };
        match self.picker.take(view) {
            Some(Ok(crate::pick_gpu::Reply::Hit(hit)))=>{self.pick_cursor=None;Some(Ok(hit))},
            Some(Ok(crate::pick_gpu::Reply::Stale))=>{
                if let Some((screen,_))=self.pick_cursor.filter(|(_,origin)|*origin!=self.anchor().map(f64::to_bits)) {
                    if let Err(error)=self.request_pick(screen,transform){self.cancel_pick();return Some(Err(error));}
                } else {
                    self.pump_pick(transform);
                    if self.picker.usage()[0]==0&&!self.picker.queued(){self.pick_cursor=None;}
                }
                None
            },
            Some(Err(error))=>{self.cancel_pick();Some(Err(error))},None=>None,
        }
    }

    pub fn set_pick_mode(&mut self, mode: crate::pick_sources::Mode) {
        if self.pick_mode != mode { self.cancel_pick(); self.pick_mode = mode; }
    }

    pub fn resolve_pick(&self, scene: &Scene, pixel: [u32; 2]) -> Option<crate::pick_sources::Target> {
        self.sources.resolve(scene, pixel, self.pick_mode)
    }

    pub fn part_usage(&self) -> [u64; 4] { let [count, bytes] = self.mesh_ink.usage(); [count, bytes, self.faces.bytes(), self.sources.bytes() as u64] }

    pub fn cancel_pick(&mut self) {self.pick_cursor=None;self.picker.cancel();}

    pub fn pick_usage(&self) -> [u64; 5] {
        let [active, pending, bytes] = self.picker.usage();
        [active, pending, bytes + self.strokes.pick_bytes() + self.paths.pick_bytes() + self.markers.pick_bytes() + self.mesh_ink.pick_bytes() + self.mesh_ink.usage()[1] + self.faces.bytes(),
            self.picker.submitted, self.picker.coalesced]
    }

    pub fn geometry_owners(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &std::rc::Rc<crate::gpu_geometry::GpuGeometry>> {
        self.meshes.iter().map(|row| &row.geometry)
    }

    pub fn usage(&self)->[u64;4]{let mut usage=crate::memory::gpu(&self.meshes);usage[1]+=self.geometry.allocated_bytes();usage}
    pub fn arena_cpu_bytes(&self)->usize{self.geometry.cpu_bytes()}

    pub fn uploaded_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
        self.instances.written_bytes + self.geometry.uploaded_bytes + self.settings_allocations as u64 * crate::object_record::BYTES as u64 + self.settings_bytes as u64
            + self.strokes.uploaded_bytes + self.paths.uploaded_bytes + self.markers.uploaded_bytes + self.grid.uploaded_bytes
    }

    pub fn set_grid(&mut self,settings:Option<crate::grid::Settings>)->Result<(),&'static str>{self.set_grid_on(settings,crate::cplane::CPlane::Xy)}
    pub fn set_grid_on(&mut self,settings:Option<crate::grid::Settings>,plane:crate::cplane::CPlane)->Result<(),&'static str>{
        let anchor=self.anchor();
        if settings==self.grid_settings&&plane==self.grid_plane&&anchor==self.grid_anchor{return Ok(())}
        let strokes=settings.map(|s|s.strokes_on_at(plane,anchor)).transpose()?.unwrap_or_default();
        self.grid.set(&self.device,strokes)?;self.grid_settings=settings;self.grid_plane=plane;self.grid_anchor=anchor;Ok(())
    }

    pub fn grid_usage(&self) -> [u64; 4] {
        let [count, bytes] = self.grid.usage(); [count, bytes, self.grid.uploads, self.grid.uploaded_bytes]
    }

    pub fn set_highlight(&mut self, scene: &Scene, target: Option<crate::pick_sources::Target>) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        if let Some(outline)=self.outline.borrow_mut().as_mut() {outline.invalidate();}
        if let Some(outline)=self.global_outline.borrow_mut().as_mut() {outline.invalidate();}
        let anchor=self.anchor();self.highlight.set_at(&self.device,&self.surfaces.active.0.get_bind_group_layout(1),scene,target,anchor)
    }

    pub fn select_objects(&mut self, scene: &Scene, ids: &[ObjectId]) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        let anchor=self.anchor();
        if let Some(outline)=self.outline.borrow_mut().as_mut() {outline.invalidate();}
        if let Some(outline)=self.global_outline.borrow_mut().as_mut() {outline.invalidate();}
        for mesh in &mut self.meshes { if let Some(row) = scene.objects().iter().find(|r| r.id == mesh.id) {
            let [calls, bytes] = mesh.update(&self.queue, row,style(scene,row.id,ids.contains(&row.id)));
            self.settings_writes += calls; self.settings_bytes += bytes;
        } }
        self.instances.set(&self.device,&self.queue,&mut self.meshes,&self.instance_rows,false)?;
        self.tiles.borrow_mut().set_records(&self.device,&self.meshes,Some(&self.instances));
        if !self.meshes.iter().any(GpuMesh::selected) {self.outline.borrow_mut().take();}
        self.set_clouds(scene,ids)?;self.sheets.set_anchored(&self.device,&self.queue,scene,ids,&self.sources.sheet_bases,anchor)?;
        if !ids.is_empty() { self.highlight.objects_at(&self.device,scene,ids,anchor)?; }self.set_scene_text(scene,ids).map_err(|_|"Cannot prepare scene labels")?; Ok(())
    }

    pub fn set_guides(&mut self,overlay:&crate::guide_gpu::Overlay)->Result<(),&'static str>{if self.guides.set(&self.device,overlay)?{self.set_scene_measure_text().map_err(|_|"Cannot prepare editing guide label")?}Ok(())}
    pub fn guide_bytes(&self)->u64{self.guides.bytes()}
    pub fn set_measurement(&mut self,mark:Option<&crate::measure_mark::Mark>)->Result<(),&'static str>{let anchor=self.anchor();if self.measurement.set_at(&self.device,mark,anchor)?{self.set_scene_measure_text().map_err(|_|"Cannot prepare measurement annotation")?;}Ok(())}
    pub fn measurement_bytes(&self)->u64{self.measurement.bytes()}
    fn merge_measurement(&self,mut labels:Vec<crate::text::TextLabel>)->Vec<crate::text::TextLabel>{if let Some(mark)=&self.measurement.mark{labels.extend(mark.labels(&labels));}labels.extend(self.guides.overlay.labels(&labels));labels}
    fn set_scene_measure_text(&self)->anyhow::Result<()>{let mut labels=self.scene_text.borrow().clone();labels.extend(self.presentation_text.borrow().clone());self.adopt_text(self.merge_measurement(labels))}
    pub fn set_preview(&mut self,draft:Option<&crate::tool::Draft>)->Result<(),&'static str>{let anchor=self.anchor();self.preview.set_at(&self.device,draft,anchor)}
    pub fn preview_bytes(&self) -> u64 { self.preview.bytes() }

    pub fn set_gizmo(&mut self, camera:&crate::camera::Camera, origin:Option<[f64;3]>, active:f32) {
        let anchor=self.anchor();let matrix=camera.view_projection_anchored(anchor);
        let layout=origin.map(|p|std::array::from_fn(|i|p[i]-anchor[i])).and_then(|p|crate::widget_layout::world_per_pixel(&matrix,p,self.size[1] as f64/self.density as f64)
            .and_then(|scale|crate::widget_layout::layout(&matrix,p,scale,self.size,active)));
        self.widget.prepare(&self.device,&self.queue,layout);
    }
    pub fn gizmo_usage(&self) -> [u64;4] { self.widget.usage() }
    pub fn gizmo_extent(&self) -> Option<[u32;2]> {self.widget.extent()}

    fn text_context(&self)->crate::text_gpu_support::GpuCtx {crate::text_gpu_support::GpuCtx::new(&self.device,&self.queue)}
    fn text_frame(&self,transform:[f32;16])->crate::scene_text_gpu::TextFrame {crate::scene_text_gpu::TextFrame {mvp:transform,origin:self.anchor(),framebuffer:self.size,logical:[self.size[0] as f64/self.density as f64,self.size[1] as f64/self.density as f64],ortho_half_height:0.,clip:{let clip=self.clipping.borrow();let mut planes=[[0.;4];6];if clip.enabled {for (p,row) in planes.iter_mut().zip(&clip.rows){*p=[row.plane.normal[0],row.plane.normal[1],row.plane.normal[2],row.plane.offset];}}planes}}}
    fn adopt_text(&self,labels:Vec<crate::text::TextLabel>)->anyhow::Result<()> {
        if labels.is_empty() {self.text.borrow_mut().take();self.text_error.borrow_mut().take();return Ok(());}
        let mut lane=self.text.borrow_mut();if lane.is_none() {let mut new=crate::scene_text_gpu::Lane::new(&self.text_context(),crate::text_gpu_support::Target {format:self.format,samples:self.targets.samples});if let Some(fonts)=self.full_text_fonts.borrow().as_ref() {new.document.replace_fonts(fonts.clone())?;}*lane=Some(new);}lane.as_mut().unwrap().set_labels(labels)
    }
    pub fn set_text(&self,mut labels:Vec<crate::text::TextLabel>)->anyhow::Result<()> {
        for (i,label) in labels.iter_mut().enumerate() {label.id=u32::MAX-i as u32;label.object=None;}
        let mut merged=self.scene_text.borrow().clone();merged.extend(labels.clone());self.adopt_text(self.merge_measurement(merged))?;*self.presentation_text.borrow_mut()=labels;Ok(())
    }
    fn set_scene_text(&self,scene:&Scene,selected:&[ObjectId])->anyhow::Result<()> {
        let labels=scene.text_labels(selected).map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;let mut merged=labels.clone();merged.extend(self.presentation_text.borrow().clone());self.adopt_text(self.merge_measurement(merged))?;*self.scene_text.borrow_mut()=labels;Ok(())
    }
    pub fn refresh_text_bounds(&self,scene:&mut Scene)->bool {
        let mut changed=false;
        if let Some(lane)=self.text.borrow().as_ref() {for row in scene.texts_mut() {if let Some(run)=lane.document.runs.iter().find(|run|run.label.id==row.id.value()) {
            let extent=run.buffer.layout_runs().fold([0f64;2],|[w,h],line|[w.max(line.line_w as f64),h.max((line.line_top+line.line_height) as f64)]);
            if row.prepared.extent!=extent {row.prepared.extent=extent;changed=true;}
        }}}
        if changed {*self.world_bounds.borrow_mut()=scene.bounds();}
        changed
    }
    pub fn text_stats(&self)->Option<crate::scene_text_gpu::TextStats> {self.text.borrow().as_ref().map(|lane|lane.stats.clone())}
    pub fn text_scene_usage(&self)->[u64;4] {self.text.borrow().as_ref().map_or([0;4],|lane|[lane.allocated_bytes(),lane.texture_bytes(),lane.stats.world_plane_rasterizations,lane.document.runs.len() as u64])}
    pub fn replace_text_fonts(&self,fonts:Vec<Vec<u8>>)->anyhow::Result<()> {if let Some(lane)=self.text.borrow_mut().as_mut() {lane.document.replace_fonts(fonts.clone())?;} else {let mut document=crate::text::TextDocument::new();document.replace_fonts(fonts.clone())?;}*self.full_text_fonts.borrow_mut()=Some(fonts);Ok(())}
    pub fn clear_text_fonts(&self) {self.full_text_fonts.borrow_mut().take();}

    pub fn text_error(&self)->Option<String> {self.text_error.borrow().clone()}
    pub fn text_usage(&self)->[u64;6] {self.text.borrow().as_ref().map_or([0;6],|lane|{[lane.document.shape_count,lane.stats.preparations,lane.stats.skipped_preparations,lane.stats.raster_images as u64,lane.stats.raster_image_capacity_bytes as u64,lane.stats.atlas_resets]})}
    pub fn text_demo(&self)->anyhow::Result<()> {self.set_text(vec![crate::text_example::label()])}

    pub fn cloud_camera(&self,camera:&crate::camera::Camera) {self.cloud_view.set(crate::cloud_gpu::View::anchored(camera,self.anchor()));self.sheets.camera(camera);}
    pub fn cloud_usage(&self)->[u64;5] {self.clouds.borrow().as_ref().map_or([0;5],|lane|lane.usage())}
    pub fn cloud_error(&self)->Option<String> {self.cloud_error.borrow().clone()}
    fn set_clouds(&self,scene:&Scene,selected:&[ObjectId])->Result<(),&'static str> {
        if scene.clouds().is_empty()&&scene.streams().is_empty() {self.clouds.borrow_mut().take();self.cloud_error.borrow_mut().take();return Ok(());}
        let mut owner=self.clouds.borrow_mut();let lane=owner.get_or_insert_with(||crate::cloud_gpu::Lane::new(&self.text_context(),self.format,&self.clipping.borrow().group));
        lane.set_samples(&self.text_context(),self.targets.samples);
        lane.set_scene(&self.text_context(),scene,selected)
    }
    fn prepare_clouds(&self,transform:[f32;16]) {
        if let Some(lane)=self.clouds.borrow_mut().as_mut() {lane.set_clipping(self.clipping.borrow().writes);if let Err(error)=lane.prepare(&self.text_context(),transform,self.size,self.density,self.cloud_view.get()) {lane.failed();*self.cloud_error.borrow_mut()=Some(error.to_string());} else {self.cloud_error.borrow_mut().take();}}
    }
    pub fn set_opacity(&mut self,value:f32){if !value.is_finite(){return;}let value=value.clamp(0.,1.);if self.opacity.get()==value{return;}self.opacity.set(value);self.cancel_pick();self.pyramid_revision=self.pyramid_revision.wrapping_add(1);for mesh in &mut self.meshes{mesh.set_xray(&self.queue,value==0.);}if let Some(o)=self.outline.borrow_mut().as_mut(){o.invalidate();}if let Some(o)=self.global_outline.borrow_mut().as_mut(){o.invalidate();}}
    pub fn opacity(&self)->f32{self.opacity.get()}
    pub fn set_outlines(&self,on:bool){self.outlines_enabled.set(on);if !on{self.global_outline.borrow_mut().take();self.outline_composite.borrow_mut().take();}}
    pub fn global_outline_usage(&self)->[u64;4]{self.global_outline.borrow().as_ref().map_or([0;4],|o|o.usage())}
    pub fn outline_usage(&self)->[u64;4] {self.outline.borrow().as_ref().map_or([0;4],|outline|outline.usage())}

    pub fn highlight_bytes(&self) -> u64 { self.highlight.bytes() }

    pub fn sheet_camera(&self,camera:&crate::camera::Camera) {self.sheets.camera(camera);}
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(crate) fn tile_buffers(&self)->[wgpu::Buffer;2]{let tiles=self.tiles.borrow();[tiles.projected.clone(),tiles.buffer.clone()]}
    pub fn set_clipping(&self,enabled:bool,solid:bool){let mut clip=self.clipping.borrow_mut();clip.enabled=enabled;clip.solid=solid;self.caps.borrow_mut().enabled=enabled;}
    pub fn set_lighting(&self,on:bool,backfaces:bool){self.surface_options.set([on,backfaces]);}
    pub fn set_ambient(&self,enabled:bool){if self.ambient_enabled.replace(enabled)==enabled{return;}let mut ambient=self.ambient.borrow_mut();if enabled{ambient.get_or_insert_with(||crate::ambient_gpu::Ambient::new(&self.device,self.format));}else if let Some(owner)=ambient.as_mut(){owner.clear();}}
    pub fn ambient_usage(&self)->[u64;5]{self.ambient.borrow().as_ref().map_or([0;5],crate::ambient_gpu::Ambient::usage)}
    pub fn ambient_error(&self)->Option<&'static str>{self.ambient.borrow().as_ref().and_then(|owner|owner.error)}
    pub fn set_depth_pyramid(&self,enabled:bool){let mut owner=self.pyramid.borrow_mut();if enabled {if owner.is_none(){*owner=Some(crate::pyramid_gpu::Pyramid::new(&self.device));}}else{*owner=None;}}
    pub fn depth_pyramid_usage(&self)->[u64;4]{self.pyramid.borrow().as_ref().map_or([0;4],crate::pyramid_gpu::Pyramid::usage)}
    pub fn depth_pyramid_error(&self)->Option<&'static str>{self.pyramid.borrow().as_ref().and_then(|p|p.error)}
    pub fn cap_error(&self)->Option<&'static str>{self.caps.borrow().pick_error}
    pub fn cap_usage(&self)->[u64;5]{self.caps.borrow().usage()}
    pub fn clipping_usage(&self)->[u64;5]{let clip=self.clipping.borrow();[clip.rows.len()as u64,u64::from(clip.enabled),u64::from(clip.solid),clip.writes,clip.buffer.size()]}
    pub fn clipping_ink_bytes(&self)->[u64;2]{[&self.mesh_ink,&self.strokes,&self.paths,&self.markers,&self.grid].into_iter().map(crate::stroke_gpu::Lane::clipping_bytes).fold(self.highlight.clipping_bytes(),|a,b|[a[0]+b[0],a[1]+b[1]])}
    pub fn clipping_error(&self)->Option<&'static str>{self.clipping.borrow().error}
    pub fn tile_usage(&self)->[u64;7]{self.tiles.borrow().usage()}

        [self.geometry.uploads, self.settings_allocations, self.settings_writes, self.settings_bytes]
    }

    pub fn draw(
        &self,
        view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        background: &crate::background::Background,
        transform: &[f32; 16],
    ) { self.draw_mode(view, background, transform, false); }

    pub fn draw_mode(&self, view: &wgpu::TextureView, background: &crate::background::Background,
        transform: &[f32; 16], normals: bool,
    ) {
        let output=view;let view=self.targets.color(output);
        let (clip_group,clip_revision)={let mut clip=self.clipping.borrow_mut();clip.frame_anchored(&self.queue,*transform,self.anchor(),self.size[1],self.density);(clip.group.clone(),clip.writes)};
        self.caps.borrow_mut().prepare(&self.device,&self.queue,self.format,self.size,{let clip=self.clipping.borrow();clip.enabled&&!clip.rows.is_empty()});
        self.prepare_clouds(*transform);
        let options=self.surface_options.get();
        let display=[f32::from(normals),self.opacity.get(),if self.ambient_enabled.get(){2.}else{f32::from(options[0])},f32::from(options[1])];
        let bytes=crate::surface_view::bytes(*transform,display,self.size,self.density);
        self.queue.write_buffer(&self.uniform, 0, &bytes);
        self.sheets.view(&self.queue,transform,self.size,self.density);
        let [r, g, b] = if self.ambient_enabled.get() { [0.94; 3] } else { background.rgb() };
        let mut encoder = self.device.create_command_encoder(&Default::default());
        let mut tiles=self.tiles.borrow_mut();tiles.prepare(&self.device,&self.queue,self.size);tiles.encode(&self.device,&mut encoder,&self.view_group,*transform);
        let tables=crate::finite_ink::Tables{projected:tiles.projected.clone(),tiles:tiles.buffer.clone(),primitive:self.targets.primitive.view.clone()};for lane in [&self.mesh_ink,&self.strokes,&self.paths,&self.markers]{lane.finite_frame(&self.device,&tables,&self.targets.depth);}self.highlight.finite_frame(&self.device,&tables,&self.targets.depth);
        {
            // The pass borrows the encoder. This scope ends that borrow before finish takes it.
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("canvas"),
                depth_stencil_attachment: Some(wgpu::RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment {
                    view: &self.targets.depth,
                    depth_ops: Some(wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(crate::depth::FAR as f32),
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    }),
                    stencil_ops: None,
                }),
                color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                    view,
                    depth_slice: None,
                    resolve_target: None,
                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color {
                            r, g, b, a: 1.0,
                        }),
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    },
                }),Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment{
                    view:&self.targets.primitive.view,depth_slice:None,resolve_target:None,
                    ops:wgpu::Operations{load:wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::TRANSPARENT),store:wgpu::StoreOp::Store},
                })],
                ..Default::default()
            });
            self.grid.draw(&mut pass,&self.view_group);
            pass.set_bind_group(2,&clip_group,&[]);
            pass.set_pipeline(&self.surfaces.active.0);
            pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.view_group, &[]);
            self.instances.bind_own(&mut pass);
            for mesh in self.meshes.iter().filter(|row|self.opacity.get()<1.||!self.instance_rows.contains(&row.id)) {if !self.instances.draw_ordinary(&mut pass,mesh){pass.set_pipeline(&self.surfaces.active.0);self.instances.bind_own(&mut pass);mesh.draw_pulled(&mut pass);}}
            if self.opacity.get()>=1.{self.instances.draw(&mut pass);}
            pass.set_pipeline(&self.surfaces.active.1); pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.view_group, &[]);
            self.instances.bind_own(&mut pass);
            self.highlight.mesh(&mut pass);
        }

### Step 14 of 19 · Retarget original ambient properties (`96zzzzzzzg-retarget-original-ambient-properties`)

- **Goal:** Prepare cached physical-sample original radius and normal sources while retaining original geometry and the one-sample ambient hierarchy, filters and history images.
- **Data Flow Trace:** `Original face radii/normals → matching physical source recipes/images → retained one-sample ambient hierarchy`
- **Files You Touch:** `src/ambient_source_pipeline.rs` (*Prepare cached original-radius/normal sample recipes and retarget only their full-resolution source images; retain the one-sample ambient hierarchy and filters.*) · `src/ambient_source_gpu.rs` (*Prepare cached original-radius/normal sample recipes and retarget only their full-resolution source images; retain the one-sample ambient hierarchy and filters.*) · `src/ambient_image.rs` (*Prepare cached original-radius/normal sample recipes and retarget only their full-resolution source images; retain the one-sample ambient hierarchy and filters.*) · `src/ambient_images.rs` (*Prepare cached original-radius/normal sample recipes and retarget only their full-resolution source images; retain the one-sample ambient hierarchy and filters.*) · `src/ambient.wgsl` (*Prepare cached original-radius/normal sample recipes and retarget only their full-resolution source images; retain the one-sample ambient hierarchy and filters.*) · `src/ambient_pipeline.rs` (*Assemble the matching original-property/depth input declarations while keeping the coarse hierarchy single-sample.*) · `src/ambient_shader_contract.rs` (*Retain both existing full Naga contracts and additionally validate both assembled original-property sample modes before their consumer is connected.*)

Match original ambient radius and normal sources to the frame sample count. Cache the ordinary and shared source recipes, and replace only their full-resolution source images when the count changes. Keep the coarse hierarchy and filters single-sample.

Ambient inputs describe the original source face, not authored display-lighting normals. The source pass uses the existing equal-depth policy and sample-qualified original world positions. Both ordinary and shared object paths retain their source geometry, placement records and original properties. The shared two-count cache selects the matching recipe without another source upload.

The image owner accounts for the physical sample count in actual byte usage. Four-sample source images remain renderable and bindable; their original integer/depth inputs are not resolved. One-sample images retain the existing readback capability used by the actual Native witnesses. A dedicated retarget operation replaces only full-resolution radius/normal images and leaves the hierarchy, coarse normals, occupancy, filtered ambient and history images intact.

Carry the same explicit physical sample through original radius, normal, primitive and depth reads. Sample zero remains the representative coarse input; sparse per-sample reconstruction also compares original primitive identity. Assemble matching texture declarations and retain full Naga validation of the original and both assembled recipes.

The active ambient owner still creates one-sample resources until its matching shader bindings and sparse corrections are connected. Existing actual GPU regressions verify source geometric normals, contact radii, shared placements, released source records, cached contact shading and image release here. The complete four-sample source/property readback is required after the remaining ambient pieces are integrated.

> **Self-Check Question:** *Which ambient resources need the physical sample count?*  
> **Answer:** The full-resolution original radius/normal inputs and their source recipes must match physical depth samples. Coarse hierarchy, occupancy, filtering and history images remain single-sample; a colour count change should retain them.

- **What You Should See:** Original radius/normal source recipes, full-resolution images and assembled shader inputs support matching physical samples. Coarse ambient images retain their existing one-sample ownership. The current ambient producer remains one-sample until the matching shaders and sparse correction path are connected.
- **Hands-On Lab Experiment:** Run the actual source-normal, shared contact-radius and cached-contact regressions. Compare the new retarget operation with full image preparation: it changes only the two full-resolution original-property images. Check that physical sample count contributes to byte accounting and no four-sample source image is averaged into an original property.

impl Images{

  let(w,h)=crate::pyramid_size::resolution((full[0],full[1]),f64::from(density));let size=[w.max(32),h.max(32)];let image=|size,format|Image::new(device,size,format);

 }

fn fullscreen(i: u32) -> vec4<f32> {
    let p = array<vec2<f32>, 3>(vec2<f32>(-1.0,-1.0), vec2<f32>(3.0,-1.0), vec2<f32>(-1.0,3.0));
    return vec4<f32>(p[i],0.0,1.0);
}
@vertex fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) i: u32) -> @builtin(position) vec4<f32> { return fullscreen(i); }
fn world(pixel: vec2<f32>, z: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    let uv = pixel / ambient.params.zw;
    let p = ambient.inverse_mvp * vec4<f32>(uv.x*2.0-1.0, 1.0-uv.y*2.0, z, 1.0);
    return p.xyz / p.w;

fn ray_origin(pixel: vec2<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    return ambient.near.xyz+ambient.near_x.xyz*pixel.x+ambient.near_y.xyz*pixel.y;
}
fn ray_direction(pixel: vec2<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    return ambient.ray.xyz+ambient.ray_x.xyz*pixel.x+ambient.ray_y.xyz*pixel.y;
}
fn depth_sample(pixel: vec2<f32>, sample: i32) -> f32 {

}
fn surface_at_depth(pixel: vec2<f32>, z: f32) -> vec4<f32> {
    if z>0.0 { return vec4<f32>(world(pixel,z),1.0); }
    let near = ray_origin(pixel);
    let direction = ray_direction(pixel);
    if direction.z>=-1e-7 || near.z<ambient.params.x { return vec4<f32>(0.0); }
    return vec4<f32>(near+direction*((ambient.params.x-near.z)/direction.z),1.0);
}
fn surface(pixel: vec2<f32>, sample: i32) -> vec4<f32> {
    return surface_at_depth(pixel,depth_sample(pixel,sample));
}
fn full_pixel(pixel: vec2<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    return floor(pixel/ambient.extent.yz*ambient.params.zw)+0.5;
}
fn position_at(pixel: vec2<f32>, along: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    return ray_origin(pixel)+ray_direction(pixel)*abs(along);
}

fn encode_normal(n: vec3<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    let p = n.xy/(abs(n.x)+abs(n.y)+abs(n.z));
    let folded = (1.0-abs(p.yx))*select(vec2<f32>(-1.0),vec2<f32>(1.0),p>=vec2<f32>(0.0));

}

    let t = max(-z,0.0);
    let xy = e-select(vec2<f32>(-t),vec2<f32>(t),e>=vec2<f32>(0.0));
    return normalize(vec3<f32>(xy,z));
}

}

fn source_primitive(at:vec2<i32>,sample:i32)->u32{

@fragment fn fs_filter_y(@builtin(position) pixel: vec4<f32>) -> @location(0) f32 {

pub struct Pipelines{pub source:wgpu::BindGroupLayout,pub level:wgpu::BindGroupLayout,pub sample:wgpu::BindGroupLayout,pub history:wgpu::BindGroupLayout,pub prepare:wgpu::RenderPipeline,pub reduce:wgpu::RenderPipeline,pub occupancy:wgpu::RenderPipeline,pub ground:wgpu::RenderPipeline,pub raw:wgpu::RenderPipeline,pub filter:[wgpu::RenderPipeline;2],pub upsample:wgpu::RenderPipeline,pub composite:wgpu::RenderPipeline}
fn pipeline(device:&wgpu::Device,source:&str,fragment:&str,groups:&[Option<&wgpu::BindGroupLayout>],formats:&[wgpu::TextureFormat],blend:bool)->wgpu::RenderPipeline{
 let module=device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor{label:Some("current ambient recipe"),source:wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(source.into())});let layout=device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor{label:Some("current ambient recipe"),bind_group_layouts:groups,immediate_size:0});let targets=formats.iter().map(|format|Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState{format:*format,blend:if blend{Some(wgpu::BlendState::ALPHA_BLENDING)}else{None},write_mask:wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL})).collect::<Vec<_>>();
 device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor{label:Some("current ambient recipe"),layout:Some(&layout),vertex:wgpu::VertexState{module:&module,entry_point:Some("vs_main"),compilation_options:Default::default(),buffers:&[]},fragment:Some(wgpu::FragmentState{module:&module,entry_point:Some(fragment),compilation_options:Default::default(),targets:&targets}),primitive:Default::default(),depth_stencil:None,multisample:Default::default(),multiview_mask:None,cache:None})
}
impl Pipelines{
 pub fn new(device:&wgpu::Device,format:wgpu::TextureFormat)->Self{
  let texture=|binding,sample|crate::text_gpu_support::texture_entry(binding,S::FRAGMENT,sample,false);let uniform=|binding|crate::tile_pipelines::entry(binding,S::FRAGMENT,B::Uniform);
  let source=device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor{label:Some("ambient source images and precise camera"),entries:&[texture(0,T::Depth),uniform(1),texture(2,T::Float{filterable:false}),texture(3,T::Float{filterable:false}),texture(4,T::Uint),uniform(5)]});
  let level=device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor{label:Some("ambient reduced original properties"),entries:&[texture(0,T::Float{filterable:false}),texture(1,T::Uint),texture(2,T::Float{filterable:false})]});
  let sample=device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor{label:Some("ambient filtered samples"),entries:&[texture(0,T::Float{filterable:true}),wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry{binding:1,visibility:S::FRAGMENT,ty:wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),count:None}]});
  let mut entries=(0..4).map(|i|crate::tile_pipelines::entry(i,S::FRAGMENT,B::Storage{read_only:false})).collect::<Vec<_>>();entries.push(texture(4,T::Float{filterable:true}));entries.push(texture(5,T::Float{filterable:false}));let history=device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor{label:Some("ambient reserved current history bindings"),entries:&entries});
  let shader=shader_source(1);let groups=[Some(&source),Some(&level),Some(&sample),Some(&history)];let prepare=pipeline(device,&shader,"fs_prepare",&[Some(&source)],&[wgpu::TextureFormat::R32Float,wgpu::TextureFormat::R16Uint,wgpu::TextureFormat::Rg8Unorm],false);let make=|fragment|pipeline(device,&shader,fragment,&groups,&[wgpu::TextureFormat::R8Unorm],false);
  let ground=make("fs_ground");let raw=make("fs_main");let filter=[make("fs_filter_x"),make("fs_filter_y")];let upsample=make("fs_upsample");let composite=pipeline(device,include_str!("ambient_composite.wgsl"),"fs_main",&[None,Some(&sample)],&[format],true);
  let reduce=pipeline(device,include_str!("ambient_depth.wgsl"),"fs_reduce",&[Some(&level)],&[wgpu::TextureFormat::R32Float,wgpu::TextureFormat::R16Uint],false);let occupancy=pipeline(device,include_str!("ambient_depth.wgsl"),"fs_occupancy",&[Some(&level)],&[wgpu::TextureFormat::R8Unorm],false);
  Self{source,level,sample,history,prepare,reduce,occupancy,ground,raw,filter,upsample,composite}
 }
}

 let source=crate::clipping_gpu::source(include_str!("ambient.wgsl"),0,5);if samples==1 {return source;}
 source.replace("const MSAA: bool = false;","const MSAA: bool = true;")
 .replace("var depth: texture_depth_2d;","var depth: texture_depth_multisampled_2d;")
 .replace("var source_radii:texture_2d<f32>;","var source_radii:texture_multisampled_2d<f32>;")
 .replace("var source_normals:texture_2d<f32>;","var source_normals:texture_multisampled_2d<f32>;")
 .replace("var source_primitives:texture_2d<u32>;","var source_primitives:texture_multisampled_2d<u32>;")
}

### Step 15 of 19 · Share ambient shader recipes (`96zzzzzzzh-share-ambient-shader-recipes`)

- **Goal:** Reuse ambient shader modules and one pipeline factory, prepare matching physical input layouts and connect retained composition bindings before activating sparse sample corrections.
- **Data Flow Trace:** `Three distinct shader sources → shared modules → explicit vertex/fragment/count recipes → retained composition inputs`
- **Files You Touch:** `src/ambient_pipeline.rs` (*Share actual ambient shader modules, match physical inputs and prepare bounded sparse sample corrections while retaining the coarse one-sample recipes.*) · `src/ambient_groups.rs` (*Share actual ambient shader modules, match physical inputs and prepare bounded sparse sample corrections while retaining the coarse one-sample recipes.*) · `src/ambient_gpu.rs` (*Connect the retained camera and bounded one-sample work buffers to the current ambient groups.*)

Create each distinct ambient shader module once per recipe set and reuse it across the passes that need it. Give the common pipeline factory explicit vertex and fragment entries, and connect retained composition inputs before activating the physical-sample owner.

The ambient, depth-reduction and final-composition sources each get one module. Reuse those modules across preparation, hierarchy reduction, occupancy, ground, raw shading, filtering and upsampling. The same descriptor factory also creates sparse edge correction from its different vertex/fragment entries, avoiding a second nearly identical pipeline descriptor.

The source layout distinguishes physical depth, original radius/normal and integer address inputs from the retained one-sample coarse and filtered inputs. Only the final colour composition uses the requested physical count; hierarchy and filtering recipes stay single-sample. The final layout binds the existing camera and reserved work buffers alongside filtered ambient. Its eventual indirect-draw buffer gains the required usage, while work storage still retains its small current one-sample size here.

The current ambient owner and canonical browser still use one sample. Its composition now supplies both required groups without changing the intended pixels. Allocation of bounded physical corrections, clearing changed-frame work and the actual sparse draw follow together in the next lesson, with independent source/property and work-buffer readback.

> **Self-Check Question:** *Why should the pipeline factory accept shader modules and entry names?*  
> **Answer:** Many ambient passes share one source module but choose different entry points and output formats. Passing the existing module avoids recreating it for every pass, and explicit vertex/fragment entries let the same descriptor build fullscreen and sparse edge recipes.

- **What You Should See:** Ambient passes reuse three distinct source modules and one descriptor factory. Physical input layouts and final composition bindings are prepared coherently; coarse recipes remain single-sample. The current ambient owner and complete browser remain one-sample until bounded corrections are connected.
- **Hands-On Lab Experiment:** Trace every ambient pass back to one of the three source modules. Compare fullscreen and sparse edge construction: only entries, formats, bindings, blending and count differ. Run current actual GPU contact/cache and geometric-normal regressions, and inspect that canonical contact shading stays correct before activating sparse corrections.

use crate::{tile_pipelines::entry,text_gpu_support::texture_entry};
use wgpu::{ShaderStages as S,TextureSampleType as T,BufferBindingType as B};
pub struct Pipelines{pub source:wgpu::BindGroupLayout,pub level:wgpu::BindGroupLayout,pub sample:wgpu::BindGroupLayout,pub history:wgpu::BindGroupLayout,pub prepare:wgpu::RenderPipeline,pub reduce:wgpu::RenderPipeline,pub occupancy:wgpu::RenderPipeline,pub ground:wgpu::RenderPipeline,pub raw:wgpu::RenderPipeline,pub filter:[wgpu::RenderPipeline;2],pub upsample:wgpu::RenderPipeline,pub composite:wgpu::RenderPipeline,pub edges:Option<wgpu::RenderPipeline>,pub composite_layout:wgpu::BindGroupLayout}
fn pipeline(device:&wgpu::Device,module:&wgpu::ShaderModule,vertex:&str,fragment:&str,groups:&[Option<&wgpu::BindGroupLayout>],formats:&[wgpu::TextureFormat],blend:bool,samples:u32)->wgpu::RenderPipeline{
 let layout=device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor{label:Some("current ambient recipe"),bind_group_layouts:groups,immediate_size:0});let targets=formats.iter().map(|format|Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState{format:*format,blend:if blend{Some(wgpu::BlendState::ALPHA_BLENDING)}else{None},write_mask:wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL})).collect::<Vec<_>>();
 device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor{label:Some("current ambient recipe"),layout:Some(&layout),vertex:wgpu::VertexState{module,entry_point:Some(vertex),compilation_options:Default::default(),buffers:&[]},fragment:Some(wgpu::FragmentState{module,entry_point:Some(fragment),compilation_options:Default::default(),targets:&targets}),primitive:Default::default(),depth_stencil:None,multisample:wgpu::MultisampleState{count:samples,..Default::default()},multiview_mask:None,cache:None})
}
impl Pipelines{
 pub fn new(device:&wgpu::Device,format:wgpu::TextureFormat)->Self{Self::with_samples(device,format,1)}
 pub fn with_samples(device:&wgpu::Device,format:wgpu::TextureFormat,samples:u32)->Self{assert!(matches!(samples,1|4));
  let texture=|binding,sample|texture_entry(binding,S::FRAGMENT,sample,false);let uniform=|binding|entry(binding,S::FRAGMENT,B::Uniform);
  let source=device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor{label:Some("ambient source images and precise camera"),entries:&[texture_entry(0,S::FRAGMENT,T::Depth,samples==4),uniform(1),texture_entry(2,S::FRAGMENT,T::Float{filterable:false},samples==4),texture_entry(3,S::FRAGMENT,T::Float{filterable:false},samples==4),texture_entry(4,S::FRAGMENT,T::Uint,samples==4),uniform(5)]});
  let level=device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor{label:Some("ambient reduced original properties"),entries:&[texture(0,T::Float{filterable:false}),texture(1,T::Uint),texture(2,T::Float{filterable:false})]});
  let sample=device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor{label:Some("ambient filtered samples"),entries:&[texture(0,T::Float{filterable:true}),wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry{binding:1,visibility:S::FRAGMENT,ty:wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),count:None}]});
  let mut entries=(0..4).map(|i|entry(i,S::FRAGMENT,B::Storage{read_only:false})).collect::<Vec<_>>();entries.push(texture(4,T::Float{filterable:true}));entries.push(texture(5,T::Float{filterable:false}));let history=device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor{label:Some("ambient reserved current history bindings"),entries:&entries});
  let shader_source=shader_source(samples);let module=|label,source:String|device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor{label:Some(label),source:wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(source.into())});
  let shader=module("current ambient recipe",shader_source);let depth_shader=module("ambient depth recipe",include_str!("ambient_depth.wgsl").into());let composite_shader=module("ambient composition",include_str!("ambient_composite.wgsl").into());
  let groups=[Some(&source),Some(&level),Some(&sample),Some(&history)];let prepare=pipeline(device,&shader,"vs_main","fs_prepare",&[Some(&source)],&[wgpu::TextureFormat::R32Float,wgpu::TextureFormat::R16Uint,wgpu::TextureFormat::Rg8Unorm],false,1);let make=|fragment|pipeline(device,&shader,"vs_main",fragment,&groups,&[wgpu::TextureFormat::R8Unorm],false,1);
  let ground=make("fs_ground");let raw=make("fs_main");let filter=[make("fs_filter_x"),make("fs_filter_y")];let upsample=make("fs_upsample");
  let composite_layout=device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor{label:Some("ambient sparse sample corrections"),entries:&[entry(0,S::VERTEX_FRAGMENT,B::Uniform),entry(1,S::FRAGMENT,B::Storage{read_only:true}),entry(2,S::VERTEX,B::Storage{read_only:true})]});
  let composite=pipeline(device,&composite_shader,"vs_main","fs_main",&[Some(&composite_layout),Some(&sample)],&[format],true,samples);
  let edges=(samples==4).then(||pipeline(device,&composite_shader,"vs_edges","fs_edges",&[Some(&composite_layout),Some(&sample)],&[format],true,samples));
  let reduce=pipeline(device,&depth_shader,"vs_main","fs_reduce",&[Some(&level)],&[wgpu::TextureFormat::R32Float,wgpu::TextureFormat::R16Uint],false,1);let occupancy=pipeline(device,&depth_shader,"vs_main","fs_occupancy",&[Some(&level)],&[wgpu::TextureFormat::R8Unorm],false,1);
  Self{source,level,sample,history,prepare,reduce,occupancy,ground,raw,filter,upsample,composite,edges,composite_layout}
 }
}
pub(crate) fn shader_source(samples:u32)->String {

 source.replace("const MSAA: bool = false;","const MSAA: bool = true;")
 .replace("var depth: texture_depth_2d;","var depth: texture_depth_multisampled_2d;")
 .replace("var source_radii:texture_2d<f32>;","var source_radii:texture_multisampled_2d<f32>;")

use crate::{ambient_images::Images,ambient_groups::Groups,ambient_pass::draw};
struct State{images:Images,groups:Groups,input:(wgpu::TextureView,wgpu::TextureView,wgpu::BindGroup)}
pub struct Ambient{pipes:crate::ambient_pipeline::Pipelines,pub sources:crate::ambient_source_gpu::Sources,frame:wgpu::Buffer,state:Option<State>,cached:Option<([f32;80],[u64;2])>,pub preparations:u64,pub writes:u64,pub passes:u64,pub error:Option<&'static str>}
impl Ambient{
 pub fn new(device:&wgpu::Device,format:wgpu::TextureFormat)->Self{Self{pipes:crate::ambient_pipeline::Pipelines::new(device,format),sources:crate::ambient_source_gpu::Sources::new(device),frame:device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor{label:Some("current ambient camera"),size:320,usage:wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM|wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,mapped_at_creation:false}),state:None,cached:None,preparations:0,writes:0,passes:0,error:None}}
 pub fn clear(&mut self){self.state=None;self.cached=None;self.error=None;}
 fn prepare(&mut self,device:&wgpu::Device,full:[u32;2],density:f32,depth:&wgpu::TextureView,sections:&wgpu::TextureView,clip:&wgpu::Buffer){
  let(w,h)=crate::pyramid_size::resolution((full[0],full[1]),f64::from(density));let size=[w.max(32),h.max(32)];
  if self.state.as_ref().is_none_or(|s|s.images.full!=full||s.images.size!=size){let images=Images::new(device,full,density);let groups=Groups::new(device,&self.pipes,&images);let group=Groups::source(device,&self.pipes,&images,depth,sections,&self.frame,clip);self.state=Some(State{images,groups,input:(depth.clone(),sections.clone(),group)});self.cached=None;self.preparations+=1;}
  let state=self.state.as_mut().unwrap();if state.input.0!=*depth||state.input.1!=*sections{state.input=(depth.clone(),sections.clone(),Groups::source(device,&self.pipes,&state.images,depth,sections,&self.frame,clip));self.cached=None;}
 }
 pub fn draw(&mut self,device:&wgpu::Device,queue:&wgpu::Queue,encoder:&mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,color:&wgpu::TextureView,depth:&wgpu::TextureView,view:&wgpu::BindGroup,clipping:&wgpu::BindGroup,clip:&wgpu::Buffer,sections:&wgpu::TextureView,meshes:&[crate::gpu_mesh::GpuMesh],matrix:[f32;16],full:[u32;2],density:f32,ground:[f32;2],revision:[u64;2],records:Option<&crate::instance_gpu::Lane>){
  if ground[1]<=0.0{self.clear();return;}if matrix.iter().any(|v|!v.is_finite())||full.contains(&0)||!density.is_finite()||density<=0.{self.error=Some("Invalid ambient view");return;}
  self.prepare(device,full,density,depth,sections,clip);let state=self.state.as_ref().unwrap();let Some(uniform)=crate::ambient_camera::uniform(matrix,full,state.images.size,ground)else{self.error=Some("Invalid ambient camera inverse");return;};
  if self.cached!=Some((uniform,revision)){
   queue.write_buffer(&self.frame,0,&uniform.into_iter().flat_map(f32::to_ne_bytes).collect::<Vec<_>>());self.writes+=1;
   let images=&state.images;let groups=&state.groups;let source=&state.input.2;self.sources.encode(encoder,&images.source_radius.view,&images.source_normals.view,depth,view,clipping,meshes,records);self.passes+=1;
   draw(encoder,&self.pipes.prepare,&[&images.linear.levels[0],&images.radii.levels[0],&images.normals.view],&[(0,source)],true);
   for level in 1..6{draw(encoder,&self.pipes.reduce,&[&images.linear.levels[level],&images.radii.levels[level]],&[(0,&groups.levels[level-1])],true);}self.passes+=6;
   draw(encoder,&self.pipes.occupancy,&[&images.occupancy.view],&[(0,&groups.levels[0])],true);
   draw(encoder,&self.pipes.ground,&[&images.ground.view],&[(0,source),(1,&groups.levels[0]),(2,&groups.occupancy),(3,&groups.history)],true);
   draw(encoder,&self.pipes.raw,&[&images.ao[0].view],&[(0,source),(1,&groups.levels[0]),(2,&groups.ground),(3,&groups.history)],true);
   draw(encoder,&self.pipes.filter[0],&[&images.ao[1].view],&[(0,source),(1,&groups.levels[0]),(2,&groups.ao[0]),(3,&groups.history)],true);
   draw(encoder,&self.pipes.filter[1],&[&images.ao[0].view],&[(0,source),(1,&groups.levels[0]),(2,&groups.ao[1]),(3,&groups.history)],true);
   draw(encoder,&self.pipes.upsample,&[&images.ao[2].view],&[(0,source),(1,&groups.levels[0]),(2,&groups.ao[0]),(3,&groups.history)],true);self.passes+=6;
   self.cached=Some((uniform,revision));
  }
  draw(encoder,&self.pipes.composite,&[color],&[(1,&state.groups.ao[2])],false);self.passes+=1;self.error=None;
 }
 pub fn usage(&self)->[u64;5]{[self.frame.size()+self.state.as_ref().map_or(0,|s|s.images.bytes()+s.groups.buffers.iter().map(wgpu::Buffer::size).sum::<u64>()),1,self.preparations,self.writes,self.passes]}

### Step 16 of 19 · Correct ambient at physical samples (`96zzzzzzzi-correct-ambient-at-physical-samples`)

- **Goal:** Connect matching original depth/address/radius/normal samples to bounded sparse ambient correction while retaining coarse images, source geometry and cached recipes.
- **Data Flow Trace:** `Matching original physical inputs → representative coarse shading → changed-sample corrections → unique bounded tiles → indirect colour draw`
- **Files You Touch:** `src/ambient_gpu.rs` (*Retain coarse ambient images while matching physical inputs and execute bounded sparse per-sample corrections without runtime readback flags.*) · `src/ambient_groups.rs` (*Retain coarse ambient images while matching physical inputs and execute bounded sparse per-sample corrections without runtime readback flags.*) · `src/renderer.rs` (*Late-enabled ambient sources and colour recipes adopt the current frame count.*) · `src/ambient_sample_inspect.rs` (*Supplied Native actual GPU resource handles expose existing inputs for independent compute; production images/buffers do not gain readback flags.*) · `src/sample_surface_tests.rs` (*Extend the supplied Native count fixture to enabled ambient resources while retaining every prior owner.*)

Connect matching original ambient properties to every physical sample and draw corrections only for samples that differ. Retain the existing coarse hierarchy and images, cache colour recipes and bound correction work by the viewport and its tile count.

A real count change selects the cached recipes, retargets only the two full-resolution source images and refreshes incompatible bindings. Coarse hierarchy, normal and filtered ambient images stay retained. Late-enabled ambient rendering adopts the current frame count. Repeating a count keeps the current resources.

Reserve one correction word per physical pixel and bounded tile flags/list storage for four-sample frames. Keep the indirect command four words long, initialize its six-vertex count once and clear only changed-frame flags and its instance count before generating work. Single-sample frames retain the small reserved buffers. Production resources do not gain readback flags.

Compose the retained filtered result across the current colour target, then use the actual indirect command to draw sparse per-sample alpha corrections. The supplied Native observer reads the existing resources through independent GPU compute: every original depth/address/radius/normal sample must agree with source geometry, correction tiles must be unique and bounded, and the real draw count must match the list. It also checks exact return pixels, retained coarse image identities, unchanged uploads and identical ordinary/shared inputs.

> **Self-Check Question:** *What prevents correction work from accumulating across changed frames?*  
> **Answer:** Clear the bounded tile flags and indirect instance count before generating changed-frame work, while retaining the fixed six-vertex count and cached images. Unique flagged tiles produce a bounded list and actual indirect instance count; unchanged frames reuse the prepared result.

- **What You Should See:** Ambient rendering supports matching physical original properties with retained coarse images and bounded sparse correction draws. Real GPU readback verifies every physical property, unique tile work and indirect counts through exact sample returns. use crate::pyramid_image::Image;
struct Images{size:[u32;2],pub linear:Image,pub radii:Image,groups:[wgpu::BindGroup;5]}
pub struct Pyramid{pipes:crate::pyramid_pipeline::Pipelines,frame:wgpu::Buffer,images:Option<Images>,input:Option<(wgpu::TextureView,wgpu::BindGroup)>,cached:Option<([u32;16],[u32;2],u32,[u64;2])>,pub preparations:u64,pub writes:u64,pub passes:u64,pub error:Option<&'static str>}
impl Pyramid{
 pub fn new(device:&wgpu::Device)->Self{Self{pipes:crate::pyramid_pipeline::Pipelines::new(device),frame:device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor{label:Some("ambient earlier camera"),size:112,usage:wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM|wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,mapped_at_creation:false}),images:None,input:None,cached:None,preparations:0,writes:0,passes:0,error:None}}
 fn prepare(&mut self,device:&wgpu::Device,depth:&wgpu::TextureView,full:[u32;2],density:f32){
  let (width,height)=crate::pyramid_size::resolution((full[0],full[1]),f64::from(density));let size=[width.max(32),height.max(32)];
  if self.images.as_ref().is_none_or(|images|images.size!=size){let linear=Image::new(device,size,wgpu::TextureFormat::R32Float);let radii=Image::new(device,size,wgpu::TextureFormat::R16Uint);let groups=std::array::from_fn(|i|device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor{label:Some("ambient previous level"),layout:&self.pipes.level,entries:&[wgpu::BindGroupEntry{binding:0,resource:wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&linear.levels[i])},wgpu::BindGroupEntry{binding:1,resource:wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&radii.levels[i])}]}));self.images=Some(Images{size,linear,radii,groups});self.cached=None;self.preparations+=1;}
  if self.input.as_ref().is_none_or(|(old,_)|old!=depth){let group=device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor{label:Some("ambient source depth"),layout:&self.pipes.input,entries:&[wgpu::BindGroupEntry{binding:0,resource:wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(depth)},wgpu::BindGroupEntry{binding:1,resource:self.frame.as_entire_binding()}]});self.input=Some((depth.clone(),group));self.cached=None;}
 }
 pub fn encode(&mut self,device:&wgpu::Device,queue:&wgpu::Queue,encoder:&mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,depth:&wgpu::TextureView,matrix:[f32;16],full:[u32;2],density:f32,revision:[u64;2]){
  if full.contains(&0)||!density.is_finite()||density<=0.||matrix.iter().any(|v|!v.is_finite()){self.error=Some("Invalid ambient depth view");self.cached=None;return;}
  self.prepare(device,depth,full,density);let key=(matrix.map(f32::to_bits),full,density.to_bits(),revision);if self.cached==Some(key){return;}
  let Some(inverse)=crate::clipping_uniform::inverse(&session_rust::Xform::from_matrix(matrix.map(f64::from)))else{self.error=Some("Ambient depth camera is singular");self.cached=None;return;};if inverse.m.iter().any(|v|!(*v as f32).is_finite()){self.error=Some("Ambient inverse exceeds display range");self.cached=None;return;}let images=self.images.as_ref().unwrap();let mut bytes=inverse.m.into_iter().flat_map(|v|(v as f32).to_ne_bytes()).collect::<Vec<_>>();bytes.extend([full[0]as f32,full[1]as f32,images.size[0]as f32,images.size[1]as f32,0.05,0.,0.,0.,0.,0.,0.,0.].into_iter().flat_map(f32::to_ne_bytes));queue.write_buffer(&self.frame,0,&bytes);self.writes+=1;
  for level in 0..6{let attachments=[&images.linear.levels[level],&images.radii.levels[level]].map(|view|Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment{view,depth_slice:None,resolve_target:None,ops:wgpu::Operations{load:wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::TRANSPARENT),store:wgpu::StoreOp::Store}}));let mut pass=encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor{label:Some("ambient nearest positive depth"),color_attachments:&attachments,..Default::default()});if level==0{pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipes.prepare);pass.set_bind_group(0,&self.input.as_ref().unwrap().1,&[]);}else{pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipes.reduce);pass.set_bind_group(0,&images.groups[level-1],&[]);}pass.draw(0..3,0..1);self.passes+=1;}
  self.cached=Some(key);self.error=None;
 }

fn level(r:&crate::renderer::Renderer,texture:&wgpu::Texture,mip:u32,bytes:u32)->Vec<u8>{
 let width=texture.width()>>mip;let height=texture.height()>>mip;let pitch=(width*bytes).div_ceil(256)*256;let buffer=r.device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor{label:Some("actual pyramid fixture"),size:u64::from(pitch)*u64::from(height),usage:wgpu::BufferUsages::MAP_READ|wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,mapped_at_creation:false});let mut encoder=r.device.create_command_encoder(&Default::default());encoder.copy_texture_to_buffer(wgpu::TexelCopyTextureInfo{mip_level:mip,..texture.as_image_copy()},wgpu::TexelCopyBufferInfo{buffer:&buffer,layout:wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout{offset:0,bytes_per_row:Some(pitch),rows_per_image:Some(height)}},wgpu::Extent3d{width,height,depth_or_array_layers:1});r.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);let(tx,rx)=std::sync::mpsc::channel();buffer.slice(..).map_async(wgpu::MapMode::Read,move|v|tx.send(v).unwrap());wait(r);rx.recv().unwrap().unwrap();let view=buffer.slice(..).get_mapped_range();let data=view.chunks_exact(pitch as usize).flat_map(|r|r[..(width*bytes)as usize].iter().copied()).collect();drop(view);buffer.unmap();data
}
#[test]
fn actual_pyramid_uses_six_nearest_positive_depth_levels_and_keeps_radius_addresses(){
 let(scene,_)=scene(false);let r=renderer(&scene);r.set_depth_pyramid(true);pixels(&r);assert_eq!(r.depth_pyramid_error(),None);let owner=r.pyramid.borrow();let owner=owner.as_ref().unwrap();let linear=owner.linear().unwrap();let radii=owner.radii().unwrap();let mut previous:Option<(Vec<f32>,Vec<u16>,usize,usize)>=None;
 for mip in 0..6{let width=(linear.texture.width()>>mip)as usize;let height=(linear.texture.height()>>mip)as usize;let depths=level(&r,&linear.texture,mip,4).chunks_exact(4).map(|b|f32::from_le_bytes(b.try_into().unwrap())).collect::<Vec<_>>();let encoded=level(&r,&radii.texture,mip,2).chunks_exact(2).map(|b|u16::from_le_bytes(b.try_into().unwrap())).collect::<Vec<_>>();assert!(depths.iter().all(|z|z.is_finite()&&*z>=0.));if let Some((before,radius,w,h))=&previous{for y in 0..height{for x in 0..width{let mut nearest=1e30;let mut chosen=0;for i in 0..4{let q=(y*2+i/2).min(h-1)*w+(x*2+i%2).min(w-1);if before[q]>0.&&before[q]<nearest{nearest=before[q];chosen=radius[q];}}let expected=if nearest==1e30{0.}else{nearest};assert_eq!(depths[y*width+x],expected,"actual reduction mip{mip} at{x},{y}");assert_eq!(encoded[y*width+x],chosen);}}}else{let index=48*width+104;assert!((depths[index]-0.5).abs()<1e-5,"original section depth: {}",depths[index]);assert_eq!(depths[0],0.,"empty depth stays absent");assert!(encoded[index]>0);}previous=Some((depths,encoded,width,height));}
 assert_eq!(r.depth_pyramid_usage()[3],6);
}

        self.surfaces.select(count,||crate::surface_pipelines::pipelines(device,self.format,&crate::surface_view::layout(device),&crate::gpu_layout::uniform(device,crate::object_record::BYTES as u64),count));
        self.instances.set_samples(device,self.format,count);
        for lane in [&mut self.mesh_ink,&mut self.strokes,&mut self.paths,&mut self.markers,&mut self.grid]{lane.set_samples(device,count);}
        self.highlight.set_samples(device,count);self.preview.set_samples(device,count);
        self.measurement.set_samples(device,count);self.guides.set_samples(device,count);
        self.sheets.set_samples(device,count);self.caps.borrow_mut().set_samples(count);
        if let Some(lane)=self.clouds.borrow_mut().as_mut(){lane.set_samples(&ctx,count);}
        if let Some(lane)=self.text.borrow_mut().as_mut(){lane.retarget(&ctx,crate::text_gpu_support::Target{format:self.format,samples:count});}
        for outline in [&self.global_outline,&self.outline]{if let Some(outline)=outline.borrow_mut().as_mut(){outline.set_samples(&ctx,count);}}
        if let Some(owner)=self.outline_composite.borrow_mut().as_mut(){owner.set_samples(device,count);}
        if self.ambient_enabled.get(){if let Some(owner)=self.ambient.borrow_mut().as_mut(){owner.set_samples(device,count);}}
        if let Some(owner)=self.pyramid.borrow_mut().as_mut(){owner.set_samples(device,count);}
        self.targets=crate::frame_targets::Targets::with_formats(device,self.size,self.output_format,self.format,count);
    }
